concept: EC2 purchasing: Spot — cheapest interruptible compute
tests: Choosing an EC2 purchasing option for a nightly batch that tolerates interruptions.
expected: Spot Instances — up to ~90% discount, for interruption-tolerant workloads. Triggers: "can tolerate interruptions and restarts", "lowest compute cost", "batch".
why_not: On-Demand is more expensive; 3-year RIs require steady load; Dedicated Hosts — expensive, for licensing/isolation.
